authorizationSource: Signal Tasks Premium Programme Phase 2 invite-hardening pack (D-018, D-019), operator go-ahead 2026-07-21

migrations.risk: additive only: two ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN (role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', last_sent_at nullable integer) on pending_invites; one CREATE TABLE workspace_events (no existing rows affected); one CREATE INDEX on workspace_events. No existing columns modified, no data deleted, no constraints removed. Existing pending_invites rows receive role='member' default, consistent with the pre-migration hardcoded value. Safe to re-run on an already-migrated DB (SQLite ADD COLUMN on existing column errors; migration runner guards re-apply).
migrations.rollbackPlan: Drop workspace_events table and index (no downstream reads yet). DROP COLUMN role and DROP COLUMN last_sent_at from pending_invites (SQLite 3.35+). The invite action falls back to hardcoded 'member' on absent column; no data loss on rollback.
postconditions: pending_invites.last_sent_at column exists and is nullable
